notices.title: 2026 tariffs — not yet verified by Toll-E
notices.body: Toll tariffs were adjusted on 1 March 2026 (SANRAL +3.12%, Government Gazette Nos. 54087 and 54088). Toll-E has loaded the published values but a person has not yet checked them against the Gazette. Every price shows its status and source — confirm with the operator before relying on it.

notices.title: N3 tariffs under review
notices.body: N3 Toll Concession's website and SANRAL's 2026 tariff poster show different N3 tariffs. Toll-E shows the poster figures and marks every N3TC plaza as under review until the Gazette is checked.

notices.title: Gauteng e-tolls have ended
notices.body: E-toll gantries on Gauteng freeways were switched off at midnight on 11 April 2024, so Toll-E includes no e-toll charges. In June 2026 Cabinet approved writing off historical e-toll debt; amounts already paid are not refunded.

notices.title: Card payments are now tap-to-pay
notices.body: News reports say SANRAL plazas stopped accepting magstripe (swipe) cards from 1 December 2025 in favour of contactless bank cards and mobile wallets. American Express, Diners Club and RCS cards are reported as not accepted. Cash and SANRAL tags remain accepted.
